components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The single high-confidence action used to add or save executive work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:var(--primary,#006fab);color:#fff;font-family:'DM Sans','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgb(0 111 171 / .18);transition:background 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out}.ds-btn-primary svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#005c90}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgb(0 111 171 / .3);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: A pale-sky operational action for previews and moving work between lists.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid #b8d3e2;border-radius:12px;background:#eaf7fd;color:#235c7b;font-family:'DM Sans','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;transition:background 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:#e1f1f9;color:#1c506c}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgb(0 111 171 / .3);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact, lifted search field embedded inside the translucent agenda toolbar.
components.css: .ds-search-field{position:relative;display:block;width:230px;font-family:'DM Sans','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}.ds-search-field svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;transform:translateY(-50%);fill:none;stroke:#536076;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-search-field input{width:100%;height:42px;padding:0 12px 0 36px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .92);border-radius:12px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / .74);color:#2c3345;font:inherit;font-size:.875rem;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgb(37 58 85 / .07);outline:none;transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-search-field input:hover{border-color:#ccd5e1}.ds-search-field input:focus-visible{border-color:#006fab;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(0 111 171 / .3)}.ds-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: A compact warm-white navigation group with pale-sky current-state emphasis.
components.css: .ds-nav{width:210px;display:grid;gap:4px;padding:10px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .84);border-radius:16px;background:rgb(244 243 239 / .9);font-family:'DM Sans','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgb(37 58 85 / .06);backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(120%)}.ds-nav-item{min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 11px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:#4b596d;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:560;text-align:left;transition:background 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-nav-item svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .7);color:#2c3345}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgb(0 111 171 / .3);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-nav-item[data-active='true']{background:#eaf7fd;color:#235c7b;font-weight:700}.ds-nav-item[data-active='true'] svg{color:#006fab}.ds-nav-count{margin-left:auto;min-width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:999px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / .76);color:#536076;font-size:.75rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Agenda Ledger Row
components.description: The signature executive-ledger row joining order, discussion, owner, status and time.
components.css: .ds-agenda-row{width:100%;min-height:88px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) auto 20px;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:17px 20px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(155 170 188 / .36);background:transparent;color:#2c3345;font-family:'DM Sans','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;text-align:left;transition:background 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-agenda-row:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .72)}.ds-agenda-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgb(0 111 171 / .3);outline-offset:-3px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / .75)}.ds-agenda-order{color:#6a788a;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-agenda-summary{min-width:0}.ds-agenda-topline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-agenda-title{overflow:hidden;color:#25334a;font-size:.97rem;font-weight:680;line-height:1.35;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-agenda-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;color:#536076;font-size:.78rem}.ds-agenda-meta i{width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#8290a0}.ds-agenda-status-ready{height:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid #b8dccc;border-radius:999px;background:#e4f4ed;color:#286450;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500}.ds-agenda-duration{color:#536076;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:620;white-space:nowrap}.ds-agenda-chevron{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:#7a899b;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-agenda-row:hover .ds-agenda-chevron{transform:translateX(3px);stroke:#006fab}

narrative.overview:
The tracker is a calm, accountable workspace rather than a generic metric dashboard. A solid GMS navy header establishes institutional identity; beneath it, a short warm-white navigation rail and a chronological agenda ledger keep attention on the next discussion, its owner and its follow-up.

The material language is frosted but disciplined. Coral, sky and lavender atmospheric bands sit behind translucent working surfaces, while crisp dividers, moderate radii and compact status marks preserve operational clarity. Decorative effects never compete with meeting preparation or decision capture.
keyCharacteristics: GMS navy identity anchored by the authentic white GMS 10 Years logo.
DM Sans throughout, with compact labels and decisive display headings.
A warm-white sticky sidebar beside a ledger-first central workspace.
Frosted panels over coral, sky and lavender atmospheric fields.
Crisp 1px separators, moderate corners and restrained shadows.
Semantic status washes that communicate readiness without visual alarm.

rules.name: The Atmosphere, Not Alert Rule
rules.body: Coral, sky and lavender belong to the background field; interactive urgency is expressed through restrained semantic washes, never large saturated blocks.

rules.name: The One Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use action blue for genuine controls, focus and current state; do not scatter it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Ledger Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep interface copy in sentence case and use weight before colour to establish hierarchy; reserve tabular numerals for counts, agenda order and time values.

rules.name: The Next Decision Rule
rules.body: The agenda ledger remains the widest and most legible surface; supporting readiness and reminder controls must not outgrow the work they explain.

rules.name: The Working Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs to stable workspace surfaces, not every control; forms and detail cells remain solid, and the no-blur fallback returns panels to Canvas Mist.

dos: Do keep the authentic white GMS 10 Years logo on the solid navy header.
Do preserve the ledger sequence: order, discussion, state, owner, duration and entry to detail.
Do use 1px dividers and muted metadata to make dense information scannable.
Do reserve the 16px panel radius for major surfaces and 10–14px radii for nested controls.
Do keep controls keyboard-operable with visible blue focus treatment and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't replace the operating ledger with generic KPI cards or decorative dashboard tiles.
Don't use coral, sky or lavender atmospheric colours as competing primary actions.
Don't apply frosted blur to forms, detail cells or every small control.
Don't introduce oversized pills, excessive shadows or ornamental gradients inside operational content.
Don't imply that sample data or simulated Microsoft integrations are live.
